newsitem.title: CHINA: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mostly down.
newsitem.headline: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mostly down.

text.p: Following is the China Interbank Offered Rate (CHIBOR) for Wednesday issued by the official Xinhua news agency on behalf of the People's Bank of China, the central bank.
The figures represent weighted averages and not closing prices and are annual percentage rates.
Turnover rose to 1.54 billion yuan from 1.368 billion on Tuesday and the 60-day contract was still the most active one.
Traders said that recent rises on the domestic A share market resulting in some buying by speculators on the interbank market while major state banks remained the major sellers.
They said the expectations of a cut in bank reserve ratios continued to put pressure on the rates.
The announcement on Wednesday that the central bank had boosted its re-discount business was likely to increase money fund supply in the mid-term, which would push the rates down, traders said.
Local traders said the rates would move in narrow ranges in the next few days.
